title: Courtesy Waiver Amount on an Apartment Home Lease
content:
The courtesy waiver amount on an Apartment Home Lease is the period's covered late fees times the waiver share, rounded half up to the cent. The period's covered late fees are all of its late fee lines, and the waiver share is the whole of them.

## Terms

- **The period** — the most recent late billing period of the lease: the billing period of the latest initial late fee line, with its due date read from the period's base rent line.
- **Covered late fees** — the sum of the period's late fee lines: its initial late fee line and every daily late fee line posted for it.
- **Waiver share** — the whole, that is 1 (100 percent).
- **Rounding** — the product is rounded once, half up, to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical late fee lines)

| Initial late fee line | Daily late fee lines | Covered late fees | Waiver share | Courtesy waiver amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $95.00 | 6 lines of $12.00 | $167.00 | the whole | $167.00 |
| $125.00 | 10 lines of $15.00 | $275.00 | the whole | $275.00 |
| $90.00 | none | $90.00 | the whole | $90.00 |

**Q. Which month's late fees are measured?** Only the most recent late billing period's; late fee lines of any earlier month are not part of the amount.
